name: @srljs/cli
description: The srl toolchain: application scaffold, dev server, project model, template checker, language server, and production delivery
author: Bernardo Giordano
//: This package ships the application scaffold, checks, language server, dev
server, and release tools. It uses the matching @srljs/core package and
reads that package's manifest for browser mounts and import prefixes.
//bin: The srl command dispatches to tool modules that also run by file path.
//files: Publish the CLI modules and omit their tests and fixtures.
//peerDependencies: The CLI checks applications against the exact core version it was released
with. A different runtime dialect could pass a mismatched checker.
//dependencies: Pin the parser, TypeScript compiler API, and bundler to versions verified
by this repository. Applications choose their own Tailwind CLI version.
//devDependencies: The artifact tests drive Chrome and do not ship these packages.
